# simgrammar · The Grammar of Simulation

> A machine-readable atlas of simulation game mechanics and the mathematical, AI, ML, and LLM results that change them. A versioned dataset of simulation game mechanics with provenance, and the paper projected from it.

dataset sha256: 7bd89fd5e2618f6f4144cc60a1034cb081f1a456383346c8cb659e03308d167a
contract: 1.0 · paper v0.2 (2026-10-25)

## Read
- https://sim.yohei.me/paper.md: the paper as markdown
- https://sim.yohei.me/references.bib: bibliography
- https://sim.yohei.me/manifest.json: counts and hashes

## Data
- https://github.com/yoheinakajima/simgrammar/tree/main/dist/tables: csv per type, edges.csv, game_mechanic_matrix.csv
- https://github.com/yoheinakajima/simgrammar/tree/main/dist/entities: full json records
- https://github.com/yoheinakajima/simgrammar/tree/main/dist/graph: jsonl, cytoscape, graphml

## Contribute
- https://github.com/yoheinakajima/simgrammar/blob/main/AGENTS.md: procedure for humans and agents
- https://github.com/yoheinakajima/simgrammar/blob/main/CONTRACT.md: invariants and validator rules
